[[Kailona]] is a [[rune trader]], a type of [[NPC]] that buys and sells [[rune]]s with prices that are based on supply and demand.

Before completion of the quest Missing Shipment:
:''"Hello! I'm Kailona. I buy and sell runes. You can apply a rune to your armor and receive its inherent bonuses for as long as you wear that piece of armor. Would you like to buy a rune today?"''
::'''What services do you offer?'''
